title: Per Semi-Saxo-Tonos (Miniature VII for alto saxophone)
program_note: Per Semi-Saxo-Tonos (Miniature VII for Alto Saxophone) was completed in December, 1998.  Unlike the previous compositions, Per Semi-Saxo-Tonos (Miniature VII for Alto Saxophone) is flexible in the options for performance:  it may be performed as a straightforward solo, as a trio in three-part can­on, or as a solo with the canon provided by tape or elec­tronics. The title refers to the canonical structure:  each voice enters one semi-tone higher than the previous—“per semi­tonos”; the “-saxo-” addition is a re­ference to the instrumentation.
